snippet.title: mcsx.mp4
snippet.description: so while i was looking for mod packs for minecraft i came across this interesting mod pack called "MCSX - Minecraft: PS1 Edition" so i installed it then loaded up the game and i created my world then when i spawned in it looked very much like the ps1 graphics. As I was walking around i got a random jumpscare shown in the video. Creepy asf
